page.overview:
Who is Dorai?

Back in 1988, before the creation of M. Bison, Gen was as originally planned to be the murderer of the father of Chun-Li, whom the sole female Street Fighter at the time was originally named "Zhi-Li" and fought with his same mantis-style of kung-fu during early stages of development, however this idea was scrapped and was instead canonized as being a friend of Gen rather than a victim.

Chun-Li's father finally made his first physical appearance in Masaomi Kanzaki's manga adaptation. In this iteration he resembles a rather heroic doppelgänger of M. Bison, who wears a blue military uniform in opposite to the evil dictator's red military uniform. However, several illustrations depicts Dorai as having little resemblance to Final Fight's Mike Haggar.

His canon name Dorai originally came from the 1995 anime series Street Fighter II V (before he was only referred as "Chun-Li's father"); it wasn't until after Street Fighter V that his name started being used in the games.

In Street Fighter ZERO Gaiden ~Chun-Li Sets off on a Trip~, his name was Wang Kaishin (王介臣, Mandarin: Wáng Jièchén; Cantonese: Wong Kaisan).
